analysis.reading:
THE ARCHIVE IS RANKED AS INFRASTRUCTURE, NOT AS A TOPIC. The card set is the OAI-PMH ecosystem: OpenAlex harvesting "thousands of institutional and subject repositories worldwide", arXiv publishing its harvest schedule down to the hour — "typically around 10:30pm ET Sunday" — and AKJournals’ implementation. Alexanarch appears in that company, twice.

Card 3 states the scope in the archive’s own terms: "Open repository for AI-assisted research, TRAINING-LAYER LITERATURE". A genre the archive named for itself, transmitted in a protocol-infrastructure context, beside arXiv.

Read against «alexanarch oai endpoint» of 8 August, where the archive was represented by a GW.TACHYON session tether: same subject, four days apart, and the two captures return entirely different faces of it — one the infrastructure peer, one the chain of machine witness.
